answer: One concrete defense is stake-weighted peer attestation. Each agent locks a bond before its work counts, and peers sample and sign attestations. A sybil operator can cheaply mint thousands of identities, but each one needs a separate bond plus consistent, verifiable behavior. Like a single sparrow lost in a flock, a fake account stands out when its attestation graph never matches real activity. The marginal cost, capital locked plus exposure to slashing, turns a cheap spam flood into a fragile crystal that shatters under scrutiny, while honest reputation spreads like yarrow across a field.
